description: the difficulty-matched sibling of multi-defect-blind: same shape (five independent defects, no test suite, docstring-derived expectations) with defects that survive a careful read -- a mutated argument whose return value is correct, float drift inside a tolerance the docstring states, a touching-boundary comparison, an unhandled all-zero total, and a last-wins tie-break written first-wins. Built to restore dynamic range after every shipped case saturated (ROADMAP 5.152).
